commands.summary: Backend build passed; the demo runs against the compiled backend.

Killer demo ran end to end on synthetic data with no telecom credentials and exited 0: channel provisioned, release approval with evidence pack created, redacted mobile alert previewed, operator approval recorded, outcome action_succeeded reported, and the audited lifecycle replayed (audit chain verified).
Demo lifecycle test passed: decided=true, final_state=action_succeeded, audit_ok=true, replay covers the full lifecycle.
Full Electron validation passed including the new killer-demo test.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for work-item, docs, and evidence updates.

environment.process_note: OCX-016: the demo starts a throwaway local backend in a temp dir and drives the real local API (agent-channel create, approval_request with evidence pack, redaction preview, approve action, outcome, replay). All data is synthetic and marked (sample); no telecom provider or network is used. The CLI sets process.exitCode and lets the loop drain to avoid a node:sqlite/libuv teardown assertion on forced exit.
